# Fekra

> Fekra is an outsourcing partner for international B2B clients, providing
> reliable engineering, talent, and delivery. The website is bilingual
> (English / Arabic) and covers services, the Fika AI assistant, a blog,
> careers, and contact.

## Pages
- [Home](/en): Overview of Fekra and its outsourcing model.
- [Services](/en/services): What Fekra offers.
- [Fika](/en/fika): Fekra's calm, friendly AI assistant persona.
- [Blog](/en/blog): Insights on outsourcing, delivery, and trust.
- [Careers](/en/careers): Open roles and how to apply.
- [Contact](/en/contact): Start a conversation or book a call.

## Arabic
- [الرئيسية](/ar)

## Notes
- Content is structured with semantic HTML and clear heading hierarchy.
- No guarantees are made regarding AI-system visibility or rankings.
